name: QIDI UltraPA Nylon (PPA) @BBL A1
filament_notes:
QIDI manufacturer data, generated by scripts/shop_profiles/gen_filaments.py.
Dry 100 C for 6 h.
Manufacturer max speed 120 mm/s.
Max volumetric speed kept at the printer profile's 12 mm3/s; the manufacturer's 120 mm/s (10.8 mm3/s) is a print-speed recommendation, not a limit.
Manufacturer recommends an enclosure; this printer is open-frame.
Product page: nozzle 260-280 C, bed 70-80 C (with PVP glue), speed 30-120 mm/s, density 1.21, drying 80-100 C 4-6 h, HDT 72.5 C, melt 231 C, annealing 80-100 C 4-6 h. Comparison guide: fan 0-50 %, any nozzle 0.2-0.8 mm, closed chamber required, HDT 79.6 C. Older wiki table listed 280-320 C, bed 80 C, hardened steel, fan 20 %.
Source: https://qidi3d.com/products/qidi-nylon-filament-ultrapa
